data.name: Hint_Backup
data.value: A backup writes the whole history (text, image and file items, including pins) to a single .db file. An encrypted backup can only be opened under this Windows account; to move it to another computer, create an unencrypted one (and keep the file somewhere safe). Restoring does not delete the current history; it adds the items from the backup (the same content is never added twice).

data.name: Hint_Export
data.value: Writes all text items, with their date and source application, to a readable (unencrypted) text file.

data.name: Chk_AutoBackup
data.value: Back up automatically once a day

data.name: Opt_EncryptQuestion
data.value:
Encrypt the backup?
Yes (recommended): It can only be restored under this Windows account. Anyone who gets hold of the file cannot read it.
No: It can be restored on another computer too, but everything in it (including passwords) can be read by anyone who opens the file.

data.name: Opt_RestoreConfirm
data.value:
The items in the backup will be added to the current history. Existing items are not deleted.
Note: if the total exceeds the limit, the oldest unpinned items are deleted on the next copy. To keep them all, raise the limit on the General tab first.
Continue?

data.name: About_Description
data.value: A lightweight clipboard history manager for Windows. It keeps the text, images and files you copy, and lets you search them with a shortcut and paste them again wherever you want. Inspired by Ditto.
